name: Vercel Daemons
desc: Long-running processes on Vercel that pull jobs and keep working.
desc_zh: Vercel 上常驻运行、持续拉取任务的长进程。
solves: Serverless functions end when the request ends, so queue workers had to live elsewhere; the daemon keeps pulling work inside the same deployment.
solves_zh: Serverless 函数请求结束就退出，队列工人只能放到别处；守护进程让它在同一个部署里持续拉活。
best_for: Your agent needs a worker that stays alive and drains a queue without another host.
best_for_zh: 智能体需要一个常驻工人来消费队列，而又不想再养一台机器。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — vercel.com/changelog directory）。 Public beta at launch. Whether Daemons existed in a private or limited form before this date is unconfirmed; the changelog entry above is the earliest dated first-party reference found. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：给智能体用的常驻进程，属于智能体平台，不是辅助工具。 首次公开日期来源：https://vercel.com/changelog/vercel-daemons-is-now-in-public-beta
